We're getting married

Amara & Theo

Saturday 12 June 2027, Hollins Barn, Cotswolds

0days
0hours
0minutes
0seconds

Our story

Two strangers, one very slow bus, and a lot of laughing since.

  1. 2019We met on the number 9Stuck in traffic for 40 minutes. Theo offered Amara half his sandwich.
  2. 2021First homeA tiny flat in Bristol with a big window and a very loud radiator.
  3. 2024Biscuit arrivesOur rescue dog, who will be walking down the aisle too.
  4. 2026The questionOn a windy hill in the Lake District. She said yes before he finished.

The day

Everything happens at Hollins Barn, so once you arrive you can relax.

1:30pm

Arrive

Welcome drinks in the orchard

2:00pm

Ceremony

In the garden, or the barn if it rains

5:00pm

Dinner

Long tables, speeches, lots of food

8:00pm

Dancing

Live band, then a DJ until midnight

Travel and stay

Getting there

Hollins Barn, Lower Slad, GL6 7QE. Free parking on site. Nearest station is Stroud, 15 minutes by taxi.

Where to stay

We've held rooms at The Woolpack Inn and Stroud House Hotel until 1 March. Mention our names for the lower rate.

Getting home

A minibus runs back to Stroud at 11pm and 12:15am. Taxis need booking well ahead.

RSVP

Please reply by 1 April 2027 so we can tell the caterers.

Will you be there?

Questions

Is there a dress code?

Summer smart. The ceremony is on grass, so maybe skip the stilettos.

Can we bring children?

We love your kids, but we're keeping the day adults only, apart from our nieces and nephews in the wedding party.

Do you have a gift list?

Your company is plenty. If you'd like to give something, we have a small honeymoon fund. Details are on the invite.

# Wedding

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/events-community/wedding/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
